chunks: Saʿd ibn Ismāʿīl narrated from his father, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, that he said:
I asked him about a man who commits sin: should salat be performed behind him or not? He said: “No.”

key_terms.خَلْفَهُ: behind him, as an Imam in prayer

ai.seo_question: Can one perform congregational salat behind a man who commits sins?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning congregational salat behind a person known for committing sin. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام answers in the negative, indicating that one should not pray behind such a person.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1115 - Saʿd ibn Ismail narrated from his father, who narrated from al-Ridha (as), that He said:

"I asked him about a man who commits sins ; should one pray behind him or not?"
Imam (as) said: "No."
